name: college-erp
description: College ERP - run frontend and backend from root

scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --prefix App/Client" "npm run dev --prefix App/Server" --names "client,server" --prefix-colors "cyan,yellow"
scripts.start: concurrently "npm run dev --prefix App/Client" "npm start --prefix App/Server" --names "client,server" --prefix-colors "cyan,yellow"
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix App/Client && npm install --prefix App/Server
